QUOTE: With asm, it is an empty `asm volatile("" : [x] "+r"(x))`, so the compiler cannot prove the value.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that the asm path is an empty `asm volatile` with the value as a `"+r"` input-output operand, and that it makes the value opaque to the compiler. It doesn't use the words "optimisation barrier", but the described purpose matches.
